$comment: Generated from storage.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to storage.yaml>`. Do not edit.

InstitutionStorage.description: One storage service the deployment's profile names as its institution's, for keeping data while a project runs (the profile's institution_storage, docs/specs/policy-and-identity.md). It holds only what the deployment vouches for: the conductor fills it into the input of an agent that mixes in GivenInstitutionStorage.

storage_id.description: The deployment's own label for a storage service, such as research-filestore: lower case letters, digits and hyphens.

profile_ref.description: The reference of the profile that vouches for the facts, as profile:<id>@v<version>; an agent cites them under it.

storage_name.description: The storage service's name, as the institution gives it to researchers.

storage_description.description: What the service is for, in a sentence or two a researcher can read.

storage_kind.description: What kind of storage service it is.

approved_for_sensitive.description: Whether the institution approves the service for personal or otherwise sensitive data. Unknown when not given, which is never taken as approval.

allows_external_collaborators.description: Whether people outside the institution can be given access to data held there.

allowance_gb.description: How many gigabytes a project may hold there without charge, where there is a limit.

charges_for_storage.description: Whether the institution charges a project for storage there.

storage_backup.description: What the service does to keep copies, as the institution states it, such as nightly snapshots replicated to a second site.

guidance.description: The pages the deployment checked the facts it vouches for against.

InstitutionStorage.title: InstitutionStorage

StorageKind.description: The kinds of storage a deployment may name as its institution's.
StorageKind.title: StorageKind

description: What the researcher says about the data the project will hold while it runs: about how much, whether it involves personal data, and whether people outside the institution need access. The conductor fills institution_storage from the deployment's profile (GivenInstitutionStorage).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

expected_volume_gb.description: About how many gigabytes the project expects to hold, where the researcher knows.

involves_personal_data.description: Whether the data involve personal or otherwise sensitive data, as the researcher says.

external_collaborators.description: Whether people outside the institution need access to the data while it runs.

institution_storage.description: The storage services the deployment's profile names as its institution's, filled by the conductor from the profile and never by the caller. Absent when the profile names none.
